content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST Project Scientist (Professional)
content_sections.text: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The Biomedical Technology Wing located at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram has issued this recruitment notification for hiring a Project Scientist (Professional) to work on software development and web development tools for the Institute (TDF) funded digital health initiative project.

rows.category_break_up: Existing – 1 OBC (In the absence of eligible OBC candidates, UR will be considered.)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.E / B.Tech Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology with 60% marks Experience in software development using PHP 35 years as on 01.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments are Rs.20,000/- + 20% HRA. The appointment is initially for a period upto 21.09.2027, likely to be extended upto 21.09.2028.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Scientist (Professional) Job Description
content_sections.text: Software development using PHP and web development tools.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SCTIMST Project Scientist (Professional)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are required to apply ONLINE through Institute website ( https://www.sctimst.ac.in/Recruitment/ ). Upload scanned copies of certificates to prove age, qualifications, experience and a valid non-creamy layer certificate (for OBC candidates) in the prescribed format applicable for employment in Central Govt. Institutions issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of a Tahsildar. Submit the application online on or before 05.11.2026 5.00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The applications will be screened and eligible candidates will be called for a Written Test and Interview to be conducted at the Biomedical Technology Wing of the Institute at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 012. Intimation regarding the schedule of written test & interview will be sent to their email id provided in the ONLINE application form. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Experience wherever prescribed means experience gained AFTER acquiring the prescribed essential qualification. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking. In the absence of eligible OBC candidates, UR will be considered.

faq.answer: There is 1 existing vacancy reserved for OBC candidates, which will be considered for UR candidates in the absence of eligible OBC candidates.

faq.answer: The last date to apply ONLINE is 05.11.2026 5.00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E / B.Tech Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology with 60% marks.

faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the monthly emoluments offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive monthly emoluments of Rs.20,000/- + 20% HRA.

faq.answer: Initially for a period upto 21.09.2027, likely to be extended upto 21.09.2028.

faq.answer: Yes, experience in software development using PHP is desirable.

faq.answer: No, marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking.

faq.answer: The written test and interview will be conducted at the Biomedical Technology Wing of the Institute at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 012.
